sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: Repair the accidental existential-pass/combinatorial logic: the single FILTER NOT EXISTS succeeds whenever any combination of multi-valued operands satisfies the checks, so additional malformed or inconsistent values can be ignored. Preserve applicability to iceStringer instances with both applicability booleans true, but enforce each required quantity as exactly one value using SHACL Core property/nested quantity shapes (minCount/maxCount, QuantityValue numericValue xsd:decimal, prescribed unit), and enforce f9=0.80, f10=1.8, and f11=1.2 there. Then use one bounded SPARQL formula constraint over those cardinality-controlled values to validate designLineLoad=max(p*h,0.15), outsideIceBeltFactor=1-hs/ls, Z, and A with the stated tolerances and conversions. Do not allow any-valid-combination semantics.

Prevent missing or malformed applicability evidence from exempting a target. Add outer property constraints requiring exactly one xsd:boolean value for both nltl:locatedOutsideIceBelt and nltl:supportsIceStrengthenedFrames, then retain the implication as explicit false-value exemption branches and a branch requiring both values true plus gen:ApplicableStringerCalculationShape. The current sh:not/sh:hasValue logic passes when either applicability property is absent or non-boolean, creating accidental pass behavior.
Candidate faithfully encodes the applicability conditions, canonical target and paths, fixed factors, unit conversions, bounded formula calculations, and tolerance-based derived-value comparisons.
